plan: Given the common knowledge of rationality, each bidder will aim to bid slightly below their true value to maximize profit. Bidding exactly at my value ($21) ensures I win if others bid rationally below their values. However, to maximize profit, I should bid slightly less, e.g., $20.9, to win against others who might bid close to their maximum values. This strategy aims to win while minimizing the amount paid.

Given my private value of $27, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while ensuring a high chance of winning. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, a rational strategy is to bid just below the value, considering other bidders will bid close to their values too. I will bid $26.9 to outbid others valuing the prize around $26 or less, maximizing my potential profit if I win.

Given that my value for the prize is $14, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a good chance to win. Bidding exactly my value or higher would not be rational, as it would eliminate potential profit. Since all bidders are rational, they will likely bid slightly below their own value. To maximize profit, I will bid $13.9, ensuring I win if others bid slightly less than their value.
